summary: Teardown/reset of an owner object that holds four counted arrays plus three optional pointers. Zeros all pointer slots, frees each counted array element (running a member destructor on 580-byte elements, or freeing per-element pointers for the 48- and 72-byte element arrays), frees each array container and the three optional pointers, then frees a trailing four-pointer block via QuadPointerFree.

operations.description: Clear field at offset 0x0 (this[0]) to 0.
If this[1] (offset 0x4) is non-null, a counted array of 580-byte elements is anchored at it with the element count stored in the header at array-4.
For each of the count elements, walk the array backwards and call MultiFieldCleanupDestructor on each 580-byte element.
Free the counted-array container (header at array pointer minus 4) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Set this[1] (offset 0x4) back to 0.
Clear field at offset 0x8 (this[2]) to 0.
If this[3] (offset 0xC) is non-null, it anchors a counted array of 48-byte elements, each element holding a pointer.
Walk the 48-byte-stride array backwards and free each element's contained pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null.
Free the pointer-array container at this[3] via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Set this[3] (offset 0xC) back to 0.
Clear field at offset 0x10 (this[4]) to 0.
If this[5] (offset 0x14) is non-null, it anchors another counted array of 48-byte pointer elements.
Walk the 48-byte-stride array backwards and free each element's contained pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null.
Free the pointer-array container at this[5] via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Set this[5] (offset 0x14) back to 0.
Clear field at offset 0x18 (this[6]) to 0.
If this[7] (offset 0x1C) is non-null, it anchors a counted array of 72-byte elements, each element holding a pointer.
Walk the 72-byte-stride array backwards (element index scaled by 9 dwords) and free each element's contained pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null.
Free the pointer-array container at this[7] via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Set this[7] (offset 0x1C) back to 0.
If this[9] (offset 0x24) is non-null, free it and conditionally free this[10] (offset 0x28) and this[11] (offset 0x2C) when non-null.
Free the optional pointers at offsets 0x24, 0x28 and 0x2C via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Clear fields at offsets 0x20 (this[8]), 0x24, 0x28, 0x2C and 0x30 (this[12]) to 0.
Return the result of QuadPointerFree on the four-pointer block at this+13 (offset 0x34).
